# Runtime artwork provenance

Generated by `python3 tools/artwork/runtime_provenance.py`; validate with `--check`.

This inventory describes the active pack, not every historical experiment. Every non-unit frame uses a 4× runtime canvas; that does not imply 4× native detail. Unit frames use a fixed 128×128 runtime canvas regardless of their own logical size (4× for the 32px-native explorer set, ~3.37×/3.2× for the 38px/40px-native worker and warrior sets). Native canvas dimensions include transparent padding. “Recovered original” includes deterministic resizing, matte extraction, layer separation and renders from original Blender rigs, without AI. “Hand-authored vector” frames are drawn by hand as SVG for glob2 (`datasrc/gfx/authored`) and rendered with librsvg by `tools/artwork/render_authored.py`, without AI or recolouring.

Catalog terrain materials use original procedural 8×8 blocks with shared boundaries and four seeded interiors. The older connected terrain frames reconstruct grass and sand from classic pixels with seeded grain and a soft color constraint, without AI; their transitions retain the previous border masks and shoreline alpha. Mask resampling adds no invented texture detail. Unit animation textures are rendered from the original Blender rigs.
